title: Tasty Bright Cucumber (Tasty Bright F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Tasty Bright cucumber: the cucumber variety, with its traits, ratings and where it grows best in the Philippines. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Tasty Bright cucumber is an F1 hybrid (Japanese burpless type) cucumber variety, also sold or known as Tasty Bright F1. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor).

heroImage.alt: Ampalaya seedlings planted through plastic mulch on raised beds, the kind of farm where Tasty Bright cucumber is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Tasty Bright F1, this is the same cucumber. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [cucumber variety finder](/crop-varieties/cucumber), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for gourds and melons](/land-preparation/cucurbit-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Days to harvest, by the seller's count: first harvest about 45 days after sowing. No trial on record checks this figure yet, so treat it as the seller's own and compare with farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cucumber fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Where and when to plant Tasty Bright cucumber

Cucumber gives its first fruit fast, often in five to six weeks. Pick a variety bred to tolerate downy mildew if you plant near the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is Tasty Bright F1 the same as Tasty Bright?
items.a: Yes. Tasty Bright F1 is another name for Tasty Bright. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tasty Bright?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
